name: Tre Fiori FC
content:
Tre Fiori FC is one of the most successful football clubs in San Marino and was founded in 1949 in the town of Fiorentino. The club competes in the Campionato Sammarinese, the top football division in the country, and is widely recognized for its long history and strong domestic performances. Tre Fiori’s traditional colors are yellow and blue, which are reflected in the club’s crest and kits.

Over the decades, Tre Fiori has won numerous national titles, including multiple league championships and Coppa Titano trophies. The club enjoyed particularly strong periods during the 1990s and later in the late 2000s and early 2020s, establishing itself as a dominant force in Sammarinese football. Their rivalry with nearby Fiorentino is considered one of the notable local rivalries in the country.

Tre Fiori also became internationally known for achieving historic results in European competitions. In 2018, the club became the first team from San Marino to win a qualifying tie in a UEFA competition after defeating Bala Town in the Europa League preliminary round. The club later earned further attention with impressive performances in UEFA tournaments, helping raise the profile of Sammarinese football across Europe.
